sentences.text: This application is for condoning the delay of 27 days in filing the appeal against the conviction of the appellant under Section 376 AB of IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
The applicant was thereafter sentenced under Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
Ms. B. Bhuyan, leaned Senior Counsel and Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam submits that she has got no objection to the delay being condoned.
Accordingly, the delay of 27 days is condoned.
